required.name: bun
required.purpose: Pinned native test and build runtime; no global install or shell-profile change

required.name: @opencode/cli-workspace-dependencies
required.purpose: Native CLI and its workspace dependency closure; exact transitive versions and integrity remain in bun.lock

nativeCheckWorkspace.name: opencode-root-check-dependencies
nativeCheckWorkspace.requiredWhen: Native package/root checks need root-owned declarations and tooling; the CLI-only filter does not link these
nativeCheckWorkspace.purpose: Install the pinned root workspace tooling, not all web/desktop workspaces; preserve the original manifest and lockfile

javascriptCompiler.purpose: Separate compiler identity; not a replacement for the native strict-check requirement

nativeCheckToolchain.declaredConfiguration: CLI extends @tsconfig/bun with skipLibCheck:true and references core; core emits declarations and incremental state under node_modules/.ts-dist
nativeCheckToolchain.requiredAcceptance: Retain the complete-input strict/library check with skipLibCheck:false and skipDefaultLibCheck:false; declared-config success would not replace it

localBuildInputs.channel: Set OPENCODE_CHANNEL explicitly to local; otherwise packages/script may derive it from the branch
localBuildInputs.version: Set OPENCODE_VERSION explicitly; otherwise latest-channel version discovery can fetch the npm registry
localBuildInputs.releaseNotes: OPENCODE_RELEASE_NOTES is text, not a path
localBuildInputs.bunCompileRelease: Keep BUN_COMPILE_RELEASE unset for the reviewed local route; setting it enables GitHub release downloads and unzip
localBuildInputs.webArchive: --skip-web-ui retains the supported empty archive without building the web workspace
localBuildInputs.output: Use a freshly absent --outdir path; the supported builder removes that selected path before building

nodeArtifactBuild.name: node
nodeArtifactBuild.requiredWhen: Building or verifying the Node artifact/OpenTUI Node renderer; Bun-native tests do not require Node26
nodeArtifactBuild.existingVerifiedScratchRuntime: not a bootstrap installation or stable runtime path

policy.lifecycleScripts: disabled; any required specific postinstall must be reviewed separately
